description: This file defines a PHP class and functions for an XML-RPC server implementation, including capabilities, method dispatching, request parsing, and error handling.

classes.name: xmlrpc_server
classes.description: A class implementing an XML-RPC server with request parsing, method dispatch, and response handling.

methods.name: serializeDebug
methods.description: Return a string with the serialized representation of all debug info.

methods.name: service
methods.description: Execute the xmlrpc request, printing the response.

methods.name: add_to_map
methods.description: Add a method to the dispatch map.

methods.name: verifySignature
methods.description: Verify type and number of parameters received against known signatures.

methods.name: parseRequestHeaders
methods.description: Parse HTTP headers and decompress request if needed.

methods.name: parseRequest
methods.description: Parse an XML chunk containing an xmlrpc request and execute the corresponding PHP function.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Execute a method invoked by the client, checking parameters and calling the registered function.

methods.name: debugmsg
methods.description: Add a string to the internal debug message log.

methods.name: xml_header
methods.description: Generate XML header with optional charset encoding.

methods.name: echoInput
methods.description: Deprecated: Echo back the input packet as a string value.
